title: prunella alba
intro: Prunella alba, commonly known as Selfheal, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family, native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Prunella alba include antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, making it effective in treating various skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and rosmarinic acid, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
